name: Python ecosystem fuzzer and AI bug-hunting tools

mentions.name: Python ecosystem fuzzer and AI bug-hunting tools
mentions.description: This project develops fuzzers and AI tools for hunting bugs in the Python ecosystem, and offers to analyze Python packages and extensions submitted by others.
mentions.problem: Bugs in Python ecosystem packages and extensions going undetected.
mentions.audience: Python package and extension developers/maintainers, who are invited to submit their projects for analysis
mentions.source_excerpt: Hunting bugs in the Python ecosystem using fuzzers and AI tools I develop. If you have a Python package or extension you'd like analyzed, just let me know.
mentions.author: lumpa
